(Japanese: '''ニビシティ''' ''{{tt|Nibi City|Pewter City}}'') is the first chapter of the [[Pokémon Zensho]] manga.

==Plot==
When {{Zensho|Satoshi}} is about to leave [[Pallet Town]], Satoshi's mom gives him a present, a new pair of gloves. Then {{Zensho|Shigeru}}'s [[Daisy Oak|sister]] comes from outside and gives him a [[Town Map]] even though Shigeru told her not to give Satoshi the map, but she decided to give the map to him anyway. All packed up, Satoshi leaves for [[Viridian City]].

While in Viridian City, Satoshi is amazed at how big it is. He then sees the city's [[Viridian Gym|Gym]] and remembers how he must get all eight [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s to get in the [[Pokémon League]] and battle the [[Elite Four]]. Satoshi tries to enter the Gym, but a little boy in a {{tc|Camper|boy scout's}} uniform tells him that the Gym is closed. So Satoshi is told to go through [[Viridian Forest]] to get to the next nearest [[Pewter Gym|Gym]]. So Satoshi goes through the forest, eventually finding a {{p|Pikachu}} chasing an acorn. The Pikachu, after seeing Satoshi, leaps behind a bush and hides. Satoshi picks up an acorn to convince he's friendly, which brings Pikachu out of hiding and it decides decides to join Satoshi on his journey.

Satoshi finally arrives in [[Pewter City]] and sees a {{tc|Fisherman}} and a {{tc|Camper}} fighting. Then, a camper shows Satoshi the city's [[Fossil]] exhibit while telling him of [[Brock]], the [[Gym Leader]] of Pewter City.

The Camper takes Satoshi to the Gym. While in the Gym, Satoshi challenges Brock to a battle. He brings out {{p|Onix}}, and Satoshi sends {{p|Charmander}}. Brock orders Onix to attack, Charmander dodges Onix's first attack.  Then Satoshi gets an idea, Charmander is told to chop the horn-like part of Onix's head off and Onix falls after hit. Satoshi wins the battle receives the {{badge|Boulder}} and waves good-bye to the Camper and Brock as he leaves for his next challenge.

==Major events==
* {{Zensho|Satoshi}} captures a {{p|Pikachu}}.
* Satoshi wins his first badge, the {{badge|Boulder}}, by defeating [[Brock]] at the [[Pewter Gym]].
